hero.title: Where do your customers really find you?
hero.lead: Ortsrank checks Google in every real town of your service area – not on a grid of fields and forests. See who ranks ahead of you, who runs ads and what to do next.

items.title: Real towns
items.text: Official municipality register, a radius around your location and a population filter – no invented measuring points.

items.title: Organic, ads, Local Pack
items.text: Three result types tracked separately, town by town and keyword by keyword.

items.title: Competitor matrix
items.text: In how many towns each competitor is top 3 – local businesses separated from chains and portals.

items.title: Actions, not tables
items.text: A prioritised list for every town and competitor: website, Google profile, ads.
